\section{Reproducibility and failure conditions}
\label{sec:reproducibility}

Each stage produces a mathematical object together with conditions that can be
checked independently.  Table~\ref{tab:stage-criteria} summarizes the required
evidence.  A failed condition terminates the calculation; it is not repaired
by silently changing a branch, dropping a cut, or inserting a known answer.

\begin{table}[htbp]
\centering
\small
\begin{tabularx}{\textwidth}{@{}L{0.20\textwidth}YY@{}}
\toprule
Stage & Object & Required evidence\\
\midrule
Collinear projection
& Dirac- and color-contracted ordered interference
& Correct UU, LL, or TT distribution product; no undeclared spin vector or
  distribution remains.\\
Physical phase space
& Oriented cut integral
& Momentum conservation, positive-energy cuts, and physical measure agree
  with Eq.~\eqref{eq:physical-m-particle-phase-space}.\\
Partial fractions
& Sum of independent denominator products
& Exact equality to the literal propagator product; every term retains every
  mandatory cut.\\
Causal classification
& Ordinary and cut denominators with stated boundary values
& Each non-virtual denominator has a fixed sign, and every virtual loop
  belongs to one declared side of the interference.\\
BMHV reduction
& $D$-dimensional scalar integrals
& No evanescent scalar product remains after the dimension recurrences; cut
  slots and normalization are unchanged.\\
IBP reduction
& Rational coefficients multiplying masters
& Reinsertion of the reduction rules reproduces every target; no target or
  nonpositive cut power remains.\\
Finite-field reconstruction
& Exact rational master coefficient
& Independent prime sequence and an unused-prime identity; exact comparison
  when tractable.\\
Master evaluation
& Analytic Laurent function
& Differential equations or direct integration, analytic boundary data,
  stated contour and branch, and an independent numerical comparison.\\
Hard reconstruction
& $H^{(n)}(v,w,\eps)$
& Independence of momentum fractions and auxiliary vectors; exact endpoint
  branches identified before the distributional expansion.\\
\bottomrule
\end{tabularx}
\caption{Mathematical objects and acceptance criteria along the calculation.}
\label{tab:stage-criteria}
\end{table}

The analytic result and the numerical comparison are kept separate.  An
\AMFlow\ value records the family, propagator powers, cut prescription,
dimension, physical point, and normalization used in the comparison.  An
analytic master record additionally contains the exact parameterization or
differential system, boundary data, branch chamber, and Laurent expression.
The latter is the result used in the hard function.

For long rational coefficients, the reconstruction record contains the exact
input operation graph, variable ordering, removed monomial, prime sequence,
and verification primes.  These data allow the rational identity to be tested
without retaining the much larger intermediate symbolic sum.  They do not
encode any master-integral value.

The present evidence establishes the six-master NLO real-emission basis, the
two exact NLO endpoint branches, the UU singular fixed-order comparison, the
342-master NNLO double-real reduction, one exact NNLO hard master coefficient,
and the analytic eight-master family in
Section~\ref{sec:nnlo-double-real}.  It does not yet establish the analytic
evaluation of every NNLO master or a complete NNLO hard function.
